findings.message: Potential AWS Access Key ID detected.
findings.recommendation: Never hardcode AWS keys. Use environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID), IAM roles, or AWS Secrets Manager.

findings.message: Potential GitHub personal access or OAuth token detected.
findings.recommendation: Revoke and rotate the GitHub token immediately in GitHub Settings > Developer settings.

findings.message: Potential Slack API bot or user token detected.
findings.recommendation: Revoke the Slack token via the Slack API admin dashboard and use secure secret injection.

findings.message: Potentially unsafe dynamic code execution using eval() or exec().
findings.recommendation: Avoid eval()/exec() with dynamic or user-influenced data to prevent arbitrary code execution (CWE-95). Use ast.literal_eval() or safe parser alternatives.

findings.message: Hardcoded local loopback URL endpoint detected in code.
findings.recommendation: Ensure development endpoints are parameterized via environment variables before deploying to production.
